upstream.note: Human-readable pointer only; the gitlink is the authoritative pin. Resolved live by run_upstream.py in resolution order: sources/firstmate, $FIRSTMATE_HOME/$FM_REAL_HOME/$FM_CHECKOUT, live checkout sibling. Upstream tests are read-only input and are never patched.

selection_rule: One representative upstream test per depended-on contract in schema/contracts.yaml. backlog is derived from fleet_snapshot and status_tail has no owning script (both adapter-native); their upstream reference is the file tail / derived projection itself, mirroring tests/conformance/test_conformance.py. Representatives were chosen as the fastest hermetic passers at seed time; slower or live-dependent siblings (e.g. fm-bearings-snapshot, fm-spawn-batch) remain tracked upstream but are not seed-gating.

tests.upstream_note: Read-only fleet snapshot and its human renderer over fm-fleet-snapshot.sh --json with schema fm-fleet-snapshot.v1 (INVENTORY.md). Hermetic and fast at seed time.
Derived surface (no owning script): backlog records plus per-state counts derived from the same snapshot. Upstream reference is the snapshot itself; harness proves derivation on both paths.
Deterministic current-state read reconciling run-step, pane, and status log; harness additionally pins the stricter-is-conformant traversal refusal (div-stricter-id).
No owning script (adapter-native bounded confined file read). Upstream reference is the file tail itself plus confinement both sides agree on, mirroring conformance StatusTailEquivalenceTest.
Plain-text steer path only (500-char single line, slash-command refusal); --key/--raw/lifecycle verbs out of scope per schema/contracts.yaml.

Safe flag subset only (task, project, mode, yolo) with approval gate; batch-dispatch coverage (every id=repo pair dispatched and reported) exercises the owning fm-spawn.sh surface. Passes at the pinned submodule; the fork's newer copy diverges and is not authoritative.
